name: chat-complex-questions-see-every-match
description: A subject becomes every file it describes (name, description, tags, text; singular forms; 'or' alternatives), so counts, sizes, orders and duplicates are not capped by search. Both named people, excluded people, top N, size bounds, seasons, sort words and bare follow-ups narrow the answer; per-year breakdowns and 'the most space' name totals and the largest files. Mirrors the macOS ChatComplexQueryTests bench on 318 files.
